ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels form large contiguous regions in the center of both lobes. Low-intensity dark pixels are mapped to the perimeter of the median notch, the trailing edges, and the distal tips. Distinct dark speckling and mottling are visible within the high-intensity field of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 35 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-20 pixels. The boundary exhibits multiple jagged peaks and deep valleys along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edge is predominantly convex, tapering to sharp upward sweeps at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel formations (barnacles) are localized on the distal tips. Several small white circular 'rosette' scars are detected on the dark-pigmented inner margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent vertical low-intensity linear disruption is visible on the white field of the right lobe. Shorter, diagonal linear marks are visible on the lower-medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization on the upper distal margins of both lobes, creating a non-uniform silhouette. A small dark mark is present on the lower-middle section of the right lobe's high-intensity field.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe distal tip shows a significantly more jagged silhouette due to dense barnacle encrustation compared to the left tip.
